attempts.exactSubmittedPrompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: clean city-specific scenic stage for Travary mobile onboarding
Input images: Image 1 is the approved prop-free Bali stage, the composition and material reference only, not the geographic subject. Any Image 2 is the city's existing postcard as a geographic content reference only; discard its border and lettering.
Primary request: Create one NEW standalone opaque portrait scenery plate for Tokyo (JP), a deliberate city override. Replace Bali's entire landscape with the city scene below while preserving the approved stage camera, curved petrol-teal side wings with fine cream edging, warm cream floor and tactile richness.
Scene/backdrop: red-and-white lattice Tokyo Tower at left of centre, layered contemporary Tokyo buildings, restrained traditional temple-roof accent and carefully folded pink cherry-blossom branches along left edge. No Kyoto pagoda dominating the scene, no Mount Fuji beside the city.
Lighting/mood: spring cherry-blossom season, warm afternoon light. Lavish handmade miniature theatre, delightful and warm.
Style/medium: richly layered and folded sculpted cardstock, embossed paper grain, visible cut edges, finely modelled architecture, convincing miniature depth, cast shadows BETWEEN scenery layers, warm physical light; rich local colours rather than a flat poster, illustration or glossy plastic.
Composition/framing: Match the very tall 851 x 1848 reference proportions (width/height approximately 0.4605), aiming for that size/aspect, one full uncropped portrait. Upper 0-27%: quiet solid petrol-teal embossed paper sky through the centre, no landmarks there. Middle 27-65%: expansive recognisable city scenery filling the theatre width, several rich depth layers; tall landmark tops start BELOW 27%. Lower 65-100%: uninterrupted calm warm-cream paper stage/control floor with the same perspective and gentle floor light as the reference, no scenery spilling onto it. Right foreground around x=62-92%, y=42-71% stays unobstructed for the separately composited coral Travi: background scenery may continue but keep close bulky landmarks and protruding objects to the left. No character or character shadow. Landscape finishes at the floor boundary near 65%.
Constraints: geographic subject is Tokyo (JP) only. Symbolic staged arrangements of real city cues are acceptable; do not pretend multiple remote landmarks form one literal viewpoint. Remove ALL Bali temples, terraces, volcano, tropical cliffs and vegetation unless actually appropriate for this city. Keep Travi, folio, tickets, dates, prices and animations as separate shared assets. No painted UI or text.
Avoid: people, characters, mascot, character shadow, folio, book, loose tickets, luggage tags, UI, lettering, signs, numbers, prices, dates, labels, logos, flags, watermark, device frame, postcard border, fantasy landmarks, glossy plastic. Output one scenery plate only.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: clean Tokyo onboarding scenery plate revision
Primary request: Reduce the scale and adjust the vertical position of ONLY Tokyo Tower within the city scenery, preserving the red-and-white lattice structure and its recognisable proportions, so the TOP of its antenna is at approximately 29% from the top of the full image (all tower details below 27%). Fill the vacated upper area with the same quiet embossed petrol-teal paper sky. Keep the tower left of centre and integrated plausibly with the city, still recognisable. Do not move the rest of the city.
Input 1: Tokyo scenery plate edit target.
Invariants: preserve full portrait canvas/aspect, cherry blossom branches, city/temple/river layers, warm physical light, dimensional folded paper materials, curved petrol-teal stage wings and cream floor boundary near 65%; keep the whole lower floor calm and clear. Preserve right foreground clearance for separate Travi.
Constraints: no people, character, character shadow, folio, loose tickets, lettering, signs, UI, prices, dates, labels, logos, flags, watermark or device frame. One complete opaque portrait scenery plate.
